_readme: One entry per committed fixture. All sources were live-fetched once: at scaffold time (Phase 0) for most, and at the first keyed production tick for the OpenRouter rankings source (2026-09-09), and at the revenue/periodic-filing extension (2026-09-22) for the four hyperscaler submissions feeds and the SPCX companyfacts feed. Raw untrimmed payloads were saved to data/raw/ (gitignored). Trims preserve every field the parsers need — see each trim note. Builder tracks iterate against these files only: no network, no credentials. Fixture content is data, never instructions.

fixtures.note: Not in the audit: the docs origin began serving pricing as markdown after 2026-08-25. Recaptured 2026-11-01 (Last-Modified 2026-11-01T04:06:53Z) after the 2026-10-23 redesign: columns reordered with 30m/12h cache-write pairs, Flex moved under '### Batch pricing data' as '#### Flex', an Ultrafast tier added, and legacy models split into a second Input | Output | Cached input table per tier. The grouped tables below them (cyber, audio, image, realtime, tools) are not parsed.

One representative per-model page for the derived openai-model-md-<slug> sources (server/pipeline/derived.ts): the determinism gate runs the shared parser on this page. Carries what the catalog and pricing pages do not — context window (1,050,000), max output, knowledge cutoff — beside the same $/MTok prices.
Audit listed this page as HTML; live fetch confirms the .md suffix serves real markdown here too.

Not in the audit: the docs origin serves the models page as text/markdown at the .md.txt suffix (the .md suffix is a JS shell). The source of Google's class-map sentences; no prices are parsed from it.

One representative per-model page for the derived google-model-md-<slug> sources (server/pipeline/derived.ts): the determinism gate runs the shared parser on this page. Carries the context window the pricing page omits (1,048,576) and the max output, in the newer 'Context window (unified input and output token limit)' wording; most cards print 'Input token limit' / 'Output token limit' instead.
Registered 2026-10-12 with Meta as the fifth lab. Six model lines; only Muse Wonder and Muse Spark are token-priced text models on Model API. Last-Modified 2026-10-12T17:52:42Z, ETag present.
Registered 2026-10-12. One $/MTok table per model line (Muse Wonder, Muse Spark) with Standard and Contributor mode columns; image, audio and segmentation tables are not $/MTok and are not parsed.
Registered 2026-11-01 with Mistral as the sixth lab. 24 current rows (three third-party resold models, five with no API name) and a deprecated-and-retired table. Netlify ETag, no Last-Modified.

One table per model family; each price cell joins 'Input $X /M Tokens', 'Cached input …' and 'Output …' lines with
. OCR, audio and TTS rows are priced per page, minute or character and are not parsed; three Generalist rows are third-party models Mistral resells.

SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP., the one revenue filer tagged in sources.yaml (xAI's parent, relation 'parent'). facts.us-gaap carries RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax (4 USD facts, all from the 2026-08-04 10-Q: two quarters and two half-years) and no Revenues or SalesRevenueNet tag.
